description: List middles: two bets on different lines of one market at two bookmakers (over 44.5 at one, under 47.5 at the other), so both win when the result lands in the gap. Shows the gap, the profit when both win and the result when only one wins. Australian bookmakers only by default. Needs Pro or the free Pro trial; 10 credits a page of up to 100 (at most 3 pages).

league_id.description: Only this league, for example nba, nfl, afl or nrl. Leave it out for every league.

markets.description: Optional comma separated market keys, at most 20, for example winner,handicap or player_points_over_under

min_middle_pct.description: Only middles paying at least this percent of the total stake when both bets win

region.description: Keep entries whose every price is at a bookmaker in this region. Default au (Australian bookmakers). Use all for every bookmaker.

name: find_middles
title: Find middles
